title: Juice-SmeltMod
body:
A simple, lightweight server-side mod for Minecraft 1.21.1 (Fabric).
This mod adds quick smelting commands to make your gameplay smoother and more efficient.

⚙️ Features

/smelt → Smelts your entire inventory instantly.

/smelthand → Smelts the item currently in your hand.

🛡️ Permissions (LuckPerms Supported)

smeltmod.smeltall → Allows use of /smelt

smeltmod.smelthand → Allows use of /smelthand

✅ Why Use This?

No complicated setup

Fully server-side

Lightweight & optimized

Plug-and-play with LuckPerms

That’s it — simple, easy, and straight to the point!
